q: 老师说得太快，我听___懂。
en: The teacher speaks too fast; I can't understand.

q: 你的声音太小，我___不见。
en: Your voice is too quiet; I can't hear you.

q: 昨天的作业我___做完。
en: I didn't finish yesterday's homework.

q: 这个词我在词典里找了半天，还是找___到。
en: I looked for this word in the dictionary for ages and still can't find it.

q: 别担心，现在去图书馆还借___到那本书。
en: Don't worry, if you go to the library now you can still borrow that book.

q: 白板上的字太小，坐在后面的同学看___清楚。
en: The writing on the whiteboard is too small; the students at the back can't see it clearly.

q: 你说慢一点儿，我就听___懂。
en: If you speak a bit more slowly, I'll be able to understand.

q: 这份报告的数据太乱了，我整理了一个晚上也整理___好。
en: The data in this report is so messy that I couldn't get it sorted even after a whole evening.

q: 门锁着，我们进___去。
en: The door is locked; we can't get in.

q: 你在山上，山太陡了，我爬不上___。
en: You are up on the mountain, and it is too steep for me to climb up there.

q: 新桌子到了门口，门太小，搬不___去。
en: The new desk has reached the doorway, but the door is too small to carry it in.

q: 他的电话号码，我想___起来了。
en: I can't remember his phone number any more.

q: 我记得去年在会上见过这位客户，可是怎么也想___起来他叫什么。
en: I remember meeting this client at a meeting last year, but I just can't recall his name.

q: 开了一上午会，腿都麻了，我一下子站___起来。
en: After a whole morning of meetings my legs are numb and I can't stand up right away.

q: 这本词典太贵了，我买不___。
en: This dictionary is too expensive; I can't afford it.

q: 那本词典早就卖完了，现在书店里买不___。
en: That dictionary sold out long ago; now you can't buy it in the bookstore.

q: 我已经很饱了，一口也吃不___了。
en: I'm already full; I can't eat even one more bite.

q: 这么多菜，我们三个人吃到明天也吃不___。
en: There is so much food that the three of us couldn't finish it even by tomorrow.

q: 现在去机场，已经来___及了。
en: It is already too late to go to the airport now.

q: 离考试还有一个星期，现在开始复习还来___及。
en: The exam is still a week away, so it is not too late to start revising now.

q: 明天有考试，我现在紧张得怎么也睡___着。
en: I have an exam tomorrow and I'm so nervous I can't fall asleep no matter what.

q: 公司在市中心，那里的房租太高，刚毕业的学生都租___起。
en: The company is in the city centre, where rents are so high that fresh graduates can't afford them.

q: 对___起，我上课迟到了。
en: Sorry, I was late for class.

q: 明天我有事，去___了。
en: I have something on tomorrow; I can't go.

q: 我发烧了，想去也___，你们去吧。
en: I have a fever; even if I wanted to go I couldn't, so you go ahead.

q: 天气太冷，我决定___，在家复习。
en: It's too cold; I've decided not to go after all and will revise at home.

q: 这么多文件，一个人一天处理___了。
en: One person can't deal with this many documents in a day.

q: 办公室的空调坏了，太热了，我受___了。
en: The office air conditioning is broken; it is too hot and I can't stand it.

q: 这个问题太难了，我回答___了。
en: This question is too hard; I can't answer it.

q: 别担心，这点儿文件我一个人拿___了。
en: Don't worry, I can carry this small pile of documents by myself.

q: 李老师在课堂上说的那些话，我一辈子也忘___了。
en: I won't forget what Teacher Li said in class as long as I live.

q: 里面在开会，你___。
en: There is a meeting going on inside; you're not allowed in.

q: 门锁着，我怎么也___。
en: The door is locked and I can't get in no matter what I do.

q: 这个箱子太重了，我用了很大力气也___。
en: This suitcase is too heavy; I can't lift it even with all my strength.

q: 这是公司的机密文件，你们___。
en: These are confidential company files; you must not take them away.

q: 图书馆规定这套珍藏本只能在馆内阅读，读者___。
en: The library rule is that this rare edition can only be read inside, so readers are not allowed to take it out.

q: 办公室在六楼，电梯坏了，这么大的柜子，我们三个人也___。
en: The office is on the sixth floor and the lift is broken; the three of us can't carry such a big cabinet up.

q: 昨天的作文我写___，老师给了我九十分。
en: I wrote yesterday's essay very well, and the teacher gave me ninety.

q: 这个字太难了，我怎么写也写___。
en: This character is too hard; however I write it, I can't get it right.

q: 他的汉语说___，常常帮同事翻译。
en: He speaks Chinese very well and often interprets for colleagues.

q: 这些生词我___记不住。
en: I can't remember these new words.

q: 这篇课文太长了，我___背不下来。
en: This text is too long; I can't learn it by heart.

q: 这份中文报纸你看得懂看___懂？
en: Can you understand this Chinese newspaper or not?

q: 你看___看得懂这份英文合同？
en: Can you understand this English contract?

q: 你们听得见听不见___？

task: Say you can't recall it.

task: Say it is too high and you can't climb it.

task: Say you can't get back tonight.

en: The fees are too high; I can't afford them.
task: Say the fees are too high to afford.

en: I'm full; I can't eat any more.
task: Say you are full and can't eat any more.

en: I don't have time to hand in the homework now.
task: Say it is too late to hand in the homework.

en: This room is too small; it can't fit ten people.
src: 这个房间很大，住得下十个人。
task: Say it is too small for ten people.

en: I can't go tomorrow.
task: Say you can't go tomorrow.

en: One person can't do this much work.
src: 这点儿工作，一个人做得了。

task: Say you have changed your mind and are not going after all.

src: 这么多项目，我一个人完成得了。
task: Say you can't manage them alone.

en: You're not allowed in.
task: Say you are not allowed to go in.

en: The suitcase is too heavy; I can't lift it.
task: Say it is too heavy for you to lift.

en: You can't talk loudly in the library.
src: 在图书馆里可以大声说话。

task: Say you are unable to write this character well.

en: She didn't speak clearly.
task: Say she did not speak clearly.

task: Say it with the contract as the topic.

task: Say you can't explain it clearly. Do not use 把.

task: Turn it into a positive-negative question.
